SUBJECTS_all_bridge_art.label: All bridge art
SUBJECTS_all_bridge_art.title: All bridge art — game art
SUBJECTS_all_bridge_art.lead_html: Every piece of bridge art we have, one look-over (owner, 2026-10-21: “Please make a sheet with all your bridge art on it, then send it too to GPT for review and improvement suggestions.”). Superset of the suspension four-looks sheet (2026-10-21) and the drawbridge art sheet (2026-10-20): suspension parts in every tier and all four looks, drawbridge winch / raised leaf / gate / planks renders (not installed), raid plank, pit-cover plank lattice, ford stones, mushroom bridges. GPT's review: Transient/pile_2026-10-21/bridge_art_gpt_review.md.
